Name: The Harmony Path
Author: NesrynRoseAstra
Description:
[b][u][size=6]🕊️ The Harmony Path ✨[/size][/u][/b]
[i]Faith, romance & spirituality for Pelican Town[/i]
🚧 WORK IN PROGRESS 🚧
[quote][b]⚠️ Please read first![/b]
The Harmony Path is a [b]work in progress[/b]. It's being built a piece at a time, so expect [b]bugs, rough edges and missing features[/b], and expect [b]frequent fixes and updates[/b] as it grows. Back up your saves before installing, and please report anything odd (with your SMAPI log!) in the Bugs tab. Thank you for being patient with me! 💛[/quote][line]
[u][b][size=4]🌸 What is this?[/size][/b][/u]
Pelican Town has never had a place of worship... until now! The Harmony Path adds a cozy hand-drawn [b]chapel[/b], a kind and curious [b]priestess[/b], four gentle [b]spiritual paths[/b], a new [b]Devotion skill[/b], Sunday services, and even [b]romance and chapel weddings[/b]. No path is "wrong". Follow one, all four, or none at all.
[line]
[b][u][size=4]📋 Requirements[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]🎮 Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]🧩 SMAPI 4.x[/*]
[*]📜 Content Patcher[/*]
[/list]That's it! Everything else is optional. Install both folders from the download: [b][CP] TheHarmonyPath[/b] and [b][SMAPI] TheHarmonyPath[/b].
[line]
[b][u][size=4]⛪ The Chapel & the Path[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]🏡 A hand-drawn chapel with stained glass, a bell tower and a stone chimney[/*]
[*]🪨 A cobbled path and plaza that lead right to the doors[/*]
[*]🪑 Benches, lamps, flower beds, fences and trees[/*]
[*]💨 Chimney smoke drifting up on chilly days[/*]
[*]🌷🌞🍂❄️ Looks lovely in every season[/*]
[/list][b][u][size=4]🕯️ Inside the Chapel & Sunday Services[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]🔔 Pews, an altar, candles and banners[/*]
[*]🧑‍🤝‍🧑 On Sundays, villagers who follow the Harmony faith head to church and take their seats in the pews (some have favourite spots!)[/*]
[*]🎉 On festival days the festival always wins, so there are no Sunday service clashes[/*]
[*]🌱 Expansion villagers keep their own Sunday routines[/*]
[/list][line]
[b][u][size=4]👩‍🦰 Meet Sister Wren[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]🌿 The village priestess: gentle, curious and a little bit holy[/*]
[*]🎨 18 hand-drawn portrait expressions and a full walking sprite[/*]
[*]🗓️ Daily schedule, Sunday sermons, dialogue and gifts[/*]
[*]💞 Romanceable! Heart events, marriage and a custom spouse room (day and night versions)[/*]
[/list][line]
[b][u][size=4]🔮 The Four Spiritual Paths[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]☀️ [b]Sun's Blessing[/b]: growth, weather and harvest (offer a fruit or crop)[/*]
[*]🕯️ [b]Ancestors' Way[/b]: memory, family and old things (offer an artifact, book or preserve)[/*]
[*]⭐ [b]Star's Gift[/b]: night, luck and mystery (offer a gem or mineral)[/*]
[*]🌸 [b]Eternal Bloom[/b]: seasons, flowers and renewal (offer a flower or seasonal forage)[/*]
[/list][b][u][size=4]How it works:[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]🙏 Pray at a shrine and leave one offering per shrine per day. The offering decides your blessing[/*]
[*]🌅 Blessings are mild and kick in the next morning[/*]
[*]📈 Each path has five Attunement ranks that only ever go up[/*]
[*]🧭 Follow all four, one, or none[/*]
[/list][b][u][size=4]📈 Devotion Skill[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]📊 A Devotion row on the Skills tab (10 pips, like the vanilla skills)[/*]
[*]🧮 Rank 1-10 from your devotion points, and it never goes down[/*]
[*]📖 A spiritual journal (default key [b]H[/b])[/*]
[*]🖥️ Optional on-screen display, Compact or Full ([b]Shift+H[/b] cycles it)[/*]
[*]🎁 Higher ranks unlock the Blessing of Courtship and the Rite of Union[/*]
[/list][line]
[b][u][size=4]💍 Romance & Chapel Weddings[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]💌 Reach Devotion rank 9 and the church offers the [b]Rite of Union[/b], a chapel wedding[/*]
[*]👰 Sister Wren officiates (Lewis does if you marry her!)[/*]
[*]🌸 Harmony villagers attend, with petals and rice falling as you say your vows[/*]
[*]🛡️ Your normal town wedding stays as a fallback[/*]
[/list][line]
[b][u][size=4]🤝 Compatibility[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]✅ [b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b]: villagers are given faiths[/*]
[*]✅ [b]Ridgeside Village, Sunberry Village, East Scarp, Lilybrook[/b] and other expansion villagers keep their own Sundays[/*]
[*]✅ [b]Hedgewitch's Broom, Hedgewitch's Almanac, StonerVille and StonerVille Glasses[/b]: optional pairings[/*]
[*]🚉 [b]Central Station, Bus Locations, Train Station, World Maps[/b]: designed to work, please report problems[/*]
[*]🎪 Doesn't replace festivals. Sunday services pause on festival days[/*]
[/list][i]"Compatible" here means designed not to clash. This is an early WIP, so some combinations haven't been tested yet.[/i]
[line]
[b][u][size=4]⚙️ Config[/size][/u][/b]
Edit [b]config.json[/b] after the first run to toggle the journal, Sunday services, shrines, matchmaking, chapel wedding, petals, the Skills row, the HUD and more. (No Generic Mod Config Menu support yet.)
🚧 Known WIP notes
[list]
[*]🐛 Expect bugs. This is early![/*]
[*]🔜 Still to come: per-villager Blessing of Courtship scenes, Hedgewitch Moon Altar offerings, StonerVille beliefs[/*]
[*]📝 Bug reports with a SMAPI log help enormously[/*]
[/list][b][u][size=4]🔧 Install[/size][/u][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher[/*]
[*]Unzip into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder[/*]
[*]Make sure you have both [b][CP] TheHarmonyPath[/b] and [b][SMAPI] TheHarmonyPath[/b][/*]
[*]Play! Find the chapel and say hi to Sister Wren 🕊️[/*]
[/list][b][u][size=4]💛 Credits[/size][/u][/b]
Created by [b]Nesryn Astra Rose[/b]. 
Thank you to the SMAPI and Content Patcher teams and the Stardew modding community.
